octavia.name: Octavia

canon_ref.note: Garia's friend. Her body is cloth; a loose stitch lets her arm fall off and she sews it back on.

octavia.summary: Young dark-skinned [Alchemist] who runs Stitchworks in Celum and calls herself the best in the city. One of the String People, with a body of sewn cloth she has bulked up for lifting. A pushy seller who wants every new recipe she sees.

peslas.name: Peslas

canon_ref.note: Knows Selys's grandmother Isshia. Selys says he has hardly levelled since his inn grew to be Liscor's largest.

peslas.summary: Huge, loud, rich Drake who owns the Tailless Thief. Buys rounds for sad regulars and has an [Intuition] Skill he trusts. Looks down on Humans and on Erin's out-of-the-way inn.

valceif_godfrey.name: Valceif Godfrey

canon_ref.note: First Landing is his home city, not modelled as a location yet.

valceif_godfrey.summary: Confident, very fast Courier from First Landing, far to the north. Chases down a bandit band that hurt Garia, then races Ryoka on the road and wins easily with [Double Step]. Becomes a friendly rival and ally.

niers_astoragon.name: Niers Astoragon

canon_ref.note: Distant Baleros figure; only known through the anonymous chess game so far.

niers_astoragon.summary: Second-in-command of a Great Company in distant Baleros. Plays chess with Erin through Val's enchanted board without giving his name at first, intrigued by how good she is.

culyss.name: Culyss

canon_ref.note: Non-chronological Interlude; a minor one-off suitor.

culyss.summary: Smooth-talking Drake known around Liscor as a lady's man; dated Selys briefly. Tries to court Erin and is driven off for good after the tribe's female Goblins ambush him.

rockgaw.name: Rockgaw

canon_ref.note: Exact class name not confirmed; a Hob chief of a small tributary tribe.

rockgaw.summary: Hob chieftain of the small Jawbreaker Tribe, a tributary of the Red Fang. Rags ambushes and kills him to fold his tribe into her own.

lyonette.name: Lyonette du Marquin

canon_ref.note: First seen unnamed, caught stealing (2.20), exiled into the snow (2.23), named once Erin takes her in (2.25). Her own narration hints she is a Calanfer princess travelling under a false House name; treat that as a guess.

lyonette.summary: A young noblewoman posing as a minor House's daughter, caught stealing food and gear in Liscor with a desperate fireball. Exiled into the winter without gear, she is found freezing by Erin, who takes her in as inn help over her protests.

brunkr.name: Brunkr

canon_ref.note: Calls Krshia 'aunt', a Gnoll term of respect for a tribe elder; the text never says they are blood kin, so no family link is recorded (see Tkrn, who uses the same word).

brunkr.summary: A tall, armed Silverfang Gnoll warrior who leads a band to the inn meaning to punish Erin for sheltering Lyonette, seizing Erin's wrist before Krshia stops him. Krshia publicly disciplines and hauls him off once the fight at the inn ends.

halrac.name: Halrac

canon_ref.note: Class guessed from his role as the team's archer/scout.

halrac.summary: Grim, quiet Gold-rank archer of Griffon Hunt, scouting the Liscor dungeon entrance. Shoots Toren dead at range, twice, not realizing he simply gets back up.

typhenous.name: Typhenous
typhenous.summary: Older mage of Griffon Hunt, travelling with Halrac, Revi and Ulrien to scout the dungeon Toren fell into.

revi.name: Revi
revi.summary: Griffon Hunt's [Summoner]; conjures a phantom construct, Kelthor, to test the dungeon's defenses. Toren kills it, drawing Halrac's arrow.

ulrien.name: Ulrien
ulrien.summary: Griffon Hunt's front-line fighter, part of the team scouting the Liscor dungeon entrance alongside Halrac, Typhenous and Revi.

jelaqua.name: Jelaqua Ivirith

canon_ref.note: A Selphid: a bodiless parasite that wears the corpse of a willing host; she opens her chest to prove it, which makes Erin faint.

jelaqua.summary: Loud, friendly leader of the Gold-rank Halfseekers, wearing the body of a dead Human woman. She and her team step between the Gnolls, the Watch and Griffon Hunt to end the brawl at the inn, then offer Ceria a place on their team.

seborn.name: Seborn
seborn.summary: Quiet [Rogue] of the Halfseekers, a Drowned Man - a species that looks Human until it opens its mouth. Helps Jelaqua and Moore break up the fight at the inn.

moore.name: Moore
moore.summary: Huge, gentle part-Giant mage of the Halfseekers. Physically pulls the brawling parties apart at the inn alongside Jelaqua and Seborn.

dreshhi.name: Dreshhi
dreshhi.summary: Krshia's Gnoll tribemate, a [Butcher]. Worries that the loss of Krshia's shop and books has hurt the tribe's standing before an upcoming gathering of Gnoll tribes.

mars.name: Mars
mars.summary: One of Flos Reimarch's Seven, styled Mars the Illusionist. Returns to Reim's war council as the kingdom rearms for war with the Empire of Sands.

takhatres.name: Takhatres
takhatres.summary: A bird-man Garuda, one of Flos Reimarch's Seven, titled Lord of the Skies. Returns to Reim's war council alongside Mars and Gazi.

trey.name: Trey

canon_ref.note: English-speaking Earth teenager, one of two credited with waking Flos from his long grief-slumber; another sign more than one Earther is loose in this world.

trey.summary: An Earth-born English teenager, ward and attendant to Flos Reimarch alongside his twin Teresa. The pair are credited with waking the King of Destruction after twenty-two idle years.

teresa.name: Teresa

canon_ref.note: Goes by 'Teres'. Twin sister of Trey; same note on Earther origin.

teresa.summary: An Earth-born English teenager, called Teres, twin sister of Trey and fellow attendant to Flos Reimarch. Another Earther in this world besides Ryoka and Erin.

drevish.name: Drevish the Architect

canon_ref.note: Already dead when the story reaches him: the Empire of Sands sends his severed, ice-preserved head to Reim as a declaration of war.

drevish.summary: One of Flos Reimarch's Seven. The Empire of Sands kills him and sends his preserved head to Reim, which pushes Flos into open war.

tom.name: Tom

canon_ref.note: POV of 1.00C/1.01C. One of roughly fifty Earthers summoned together to the Blighted Lands of Rhir, now down to about twenty; not connected to Liscor's cast so far, but expected to matter in later books.

tom.summary: An Earther with the [Hero] and [Clown] classes, one of a group of summoned Heroes garrisoning a frontier village in the Blighted Lands. After failing to save a boy from a Troll during a Demon raid, he breaks and single-handedly slaughters the raiders, gaining grim new Clown skills.

richard.name: Richard
richard.summary: Self-appointed leader of Tom's group of summoned Earther Heroes in the Blighted Lands, a [Knight]. Finds Tom at dawn covered in blood after the massacre, unable to look at him.

emily.name: Emily
emily.summary: Second-in-command of Tom's group of summoned Earther Heroes in the Blighted Lands, a [Hydromancer].

wilen.name: Wilen

canon_ref.note: A local boy of the frontier village, not an Earther.

wilen.summary: A boy of the frontier village who watches Tom's clown act. Fatally wounded by a Troll during a Demon raid; dies in Tom's arms, the breaking point for Tom's [Clown] class.

garen.name: Garen

canon_ref.note: Former Chieftain of the Red Fang Tribe, now subordinate to Rags by his own design. A one-time Gold-rank adventurer who betrayed and killed his own party over a black key. Deliberately tested Rags with raids to find a Chieftain strong enough to face the rising Goblin Lord.

garen.summary: Huge, battle-scarred Hobgoblin, former Chieftain of the legendary Red Fang Tribe. Tests Rags with raids, loses a brutal duel to her, and submits his tribe to her - then stays on to train her and hunt for the tribe.

urksh.name: Urksh

canon_ref.note: Dies in 2.35 covering Ryoka and Mrsha's escape from the Goblin Lord's army, killed by an event effect, not a stage fight.

urksh.summary: Chieftain of the Stone Spears Gnoll Tribe, a small mining camp in the northern mountains. Takes in and treats an injured Ryoka, then organizes the desperate search when Mrsha vanishes. Dies protecting Ryoka and Mrsha as his tribe is overrun.

mrsha.name: Mrsha

canon_ref.note: Daughter of two Stone Spears warriors; cannot speak beyond small sounds. Her fur turns pure white in 2.35 for no reason the text explains.

mrsha.summary: A young, mute Gnoll cub of the Stone Spears Tribe who finds an injured Ryoka by scent. Wanders off and falls into a hidden mountain crevasse while fleeing an armored Goblin; rescued by Ryoka during the Goblin Lord's assault on her tribe.

zel_shivertail.name: Zel Shivertail

canon_ref.note: Called 'Tidebreaker'; renowned as a purely defensive commander, which makes his offensive [Glorious Charge] a surprise. His home city is not named in these chapters.

zel_shivertail.summary: Drake General nicknamed Tidebreaker, fighting an outnumbered war against Wall Lord Ilvriss. Turns Ryoka's accidental chaos in Ilvriss's camp into a winning surprise charge, later chooses to save a Gnoll tribe over killing the Goblin Lord.

ilvriss.name: Wall Lord Ilvriss

canon_ref.note: 'Wall Lord' is his title; no bracketed class is confirmed on the page for him, so none is recorded. Captures and interrogates Ryoka, then loses a duel to Zel and is kept as his honor-bound prisoner.

ilvriss.summary: Arrogant, paranoid Drake Wall Lord at war with Zel Shivertail. Captures and interrogates Ryoka, is incapacitated by her stink-potion escape, then loses a formal duel to Zel and becomes his prisoner - fighting alongside him anyway when the Goblin Lord's army attacks.

periss.name: Periss

canon_ref.note: Ilvriss's second. Her death to Az'kerash's undead is strongly implied (a shattered bonded ring, a distant scream) but never shown, so she stays alive in the data; see flag 'periss.presumed_dead'.

periss.summary: Wall Lord Ilvriss's capable second-in-command. Captures Ryoka, then leads a squad that chases her into Az'kerash's hidden maze and is caught by his undead guardians; her fate is left an open question in the text.

azkerash.name: Az'kerash

canon_ref.note: The legendary Necromancer, believed dead by most of the world. States he is turning 200 years old. Deep in an unspecified, all-consuming magical creation project; deliberately does not intervene in the Zel/Ilvriss war beyond ordering intruders killed.

azkerash.summary: The legendary Necromancer, hidden behind a living maze with an undead court, engaged in a vast unexplained magical project. Nearly kills Ryoka on reflex before recognizing Teriarch's name, reads his letter with dry formality, and lets her go unharmed.

reynold.name: Reynold
reynold.summary: Lady Magnolia Reinhart's personable Butler, driving her magical coach. Warms into genuine friendliness with Erin on the four-hour ride to the estate before snapping back into formal reserve on arrival.

imani.name: Imani

canon_ref.note: Transported to this world separately from Joseph and Rose's group of seven; the sole survivor of her own group, killed around her by monsters called Crelers.

imani.summary: A deeply traumatized Earth-transplant kept apart from the other new arrivals at Magnolia's estate, the only survivor of her group after monsters called Crelers killed the rest. Opens up briefly to Erin, who shares her own first-night ordeal.

joseph.name: Joseph

canon_ref.note: American, pulled from a Chicago airport with six others about a week before Erin's visit.

joseph.summary: Eager, excitable American among the group of Earth-transplants gathered at Magnolia's estate. Wants to become an adventurer with magical head-start gear and chafes at Ressa's restrictions on the group.

rose.name: Rose

canon_ref.note: Was travelling to France when taken from the same Chicago airport as Joseph and five others.

rose.summary: More cautious member of the Earth-transplant group at Magnolia's estate. Wants to network with other world-transported people rather than adventure, and flatly rejects the idea that this world is 'a game'.
